items.desc: The Bhotekoshi crisis must be recognised as a clear signal that we have entered a new era in our rapidly warming world.

items.title: Congress completes conventions in over 6,000 wards in 73 districts
items.desc: The first stage of the 15th general convention has brought thousands of women, youth and Dalits into local party structures. The party’s rival faction led by former chief Deuba is preparing for a parallel convention.

items.title: What fuels the leadership dispute in UML
items.desc: Calls for organisational and generational change expose a deeper divide over KP Sharma Oli’s leadership, with senior figures who once backed him now pushing for a rethink.

items.title: Children in Madhesh are falling victim to abduction, sexual violence and killings
items.desc: Recent cases in Dhanusha, Saptari and Bara have raised fresh concerns about gaps in child protection. Police and rights advocates call for stronger safeguards at home and in communities.

items.title: Nepal Airlines’ two wide-bodies are stuck in Japan and Italy. The bill is nearing Rs1 billion
items.desc: The grounding of both aircraft has disrupted international services, left passengers stranded and put further strain on the cash-strapped national carrier.

items.title: Karate’s near-misses dent Nepal’s medal hopes at Asian Games
items.desc: Erika Gurung and two other karatekas reached the semifinals but failed to secure a medal on a frustrating day in Nagoya.

items.title: Nepal lost Rs10 billion in India’s import squeeze. New Delhi seeks investigation before easing curbs
items.desc: India has also asked Nepal to facilitate market access for its agricultural and dairy products, which face restrictions in Nepal.

items.title: CK Raut re-elected unopposed as Janamat Party chair
items.desc: Raut is the sole candidate for the top post at the party’s second general convention, which will elect 100 other central committee members through a direct vote.

items.title: Diana’s brother compares media treatment of Harry, Meghan to late princess’ ordeal
items.desc: Harry, Diana’s youngest son, and Meghan, cited the impact of what they called ​a toxic media on their lives before they quit royal duties and moved to the United States ‌in 2020.

items.title: Tribhuvan University to hold graduations in all seven provinces
items.desc: Students will be able to choose a graduation centre closer to home, ending the requirement for graduates from across Nepal to travel to Kathmandu.
